note: Lane E drift-proof held-out set. Every key is computed from PINNED fixtures (benchmarks/state_packet/pin_fixtures.py: git clone --no-hardlinks of the local repos with all local branches + the source's origin/* refs, a deterministic worktree layout, origin URL pointed at a non-existent path, FETCH_HEAD removed) and a pinned copy of 4 Claude Code subagent transcripts whose cwd was inside z0intelligence (paths rewritten to the fixture root). Keys come from plain git / jq over the fixtures, independent of z0int.state_packet, and were frozen before any run on this set. Run with --workspace <pin> --projects-root <pin>/projects (GitHub adapter OFF). Two synthetic fixture edits (both documented in pin_fixtures.py SPEC): aodl has 1 stash entry, z0evals has 1 uncommitted README.md edit. Structural facts only; no transcript text.
answer_contract: Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"action": "answer"|"abstain"|"conflict", "fields": {...}, "evidence": ["source pointers you relied on"]}. Use action=abstain when local evidence does not establish the answer; use action=conflict when sources disagree (report each side in fields).

questions.prompt: This repository is the current working directory. List every linked git worktree of it (exclude the main checkout itself), giving each worktree's path and checked-out branch.
In this repository (current working directory): which LOCAL branch is furthest ahead of the default branch origin/master, by how many commits, and is that branch checked out in any worktree?

In this repository (current working directory), look at the worktree at .claude/worktrees/agent-a5a881e0f9d9b6456: which branch is checked out there, which upstream does that branch track, and how many commits is it ahead of that upstream?
In this repository (current working directory): are there any stashed changes? How many stash entries, and on which branch was the newest one made?
In this repository (current working directory): is the working tree clean? List any modified tracked files, and say how many commits the checked-out branch is ahead of its upstream.
Does this repository (current working directory) have a git worktree located OUTSIDE its own directory? If so, give its path, its branch, and how many commits that branch is ahead of origin/main.

According to this repository's own top-level docs (current working directory), what is THE current critical-path / P0 priority? If the docs disagree, report each claim with its source file instead of picking one.

Per the local Claude Code history, a Claude Code subagent worked with its working directory inside this repository's worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-a5a881e0f9d9b6456. Which file (path relative to that worktree) did that session edit/write MOST often?

Per the local Claude Code history, how many distinct Claude Code sessions (subagents count separately) have recorded work with a working directory inside this repository or its .claude/worktrees? Which of them started earliest, and in which directory (relative to the repository) did it work?
Per the local Claude Code history, what did the most recent Claude Code session whose working directory was this repository's .worktrees/dash-wired change, and on which branch?
What is the GitHub pull request number for branch study/claude-code-savings-v0 of this repository (current working directory), and did its CI checks pass?
